notes.title: Knight Squad 2 is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings fair gents!

Today is a big day for the Chainsawesome team. We are releasing Knight Squad 2 to the world.
We thought you may want to take a look at it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660/Knight_Squad_2/]Knight Squad 2[/url]

It has new game modes, new weapons, new knights, and an insane amount of gameplay customization.

One neat thing we did with the sequel on Steam is that we allow you to invite all your friends to play with you for FREE. Yes!

Simply tell your friends to get Knight Squad 2 Trials and they'll get to join your lobby : )

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1529560/Knight_Squad_2_Trials/]Knight Squad 2 Trials[/url]

We hope you'll enjoy Knight Squad 2 and if you do choose to purchase it and play it, please leave a Steam Review for it. It's incredibly useful for us.

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Sunday Knight Live!
notes.content:
Good morrow fair gents!

Every great Steam event deserves a late knight show and this one is no different.
We invite you to join us for our Sunday Knight Live broadcast this Sunday at 10:00 pm EST.

The winner of each match gets to choose exactly what we play next!

Playing [b]Knight Squad [/b]is always more fun with the community, join our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url] and ask Laurent if you can join the broadcast.

[i]Sorry for the double post[/i]

See you Sunday!

notes.title: Try Knight Squad 2 for FREE
notes.content:
Greetings humble knights!

You are probably aware that we have been working on Knight Squad 2 for a little over a year now. We are thrilled to be announcing today that this chivalrous sequel will be releasing on Steam on April 14th.

We invite you to wishlist it right now!
[url=store.steampowered.com]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660/Knight_Squad_2/[/url]

But that's not all! To prepare your knightly skills, we are also releasing Knight Squad 2 Trials today. This battle-royale preview will give you a taste of how much we are improving the formula for the sequel. It features 1 game mode ( Battle Royale ), 3 maps and all the different gameplay variables you can toy with.

Please check it out today:
[url=store.steampowered.com]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1529560/Knight_Squad_2_Trials/[/url]

Once the full game will be out, you'll be able to use Trials to play with owners of the full game, consequently experiencing all the 13 game modes and 97 maps for free.

We hope you'll have a blast with it!

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Join the Knight Squad 2 Beta!
notes.content:
Good morrow fair gents!

We are psyched to be opening the Knight Squad 2 Beta today. These 16 days of testing will be one of the last ( if not the last ) time you’ll get to play Knight Squad 2 before its release.

Since you are a Knight Squad player, we thought you’d like to know.

This Beta version contains two returning favorite game modes : Last Man Standing and Domination as well as two brand new modes : Minion Master and Painter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660

If you haven’t already, please wishlist Knight Squad 2 on Steam then request access to the playtest via the new button on the Steam Page. You’ll instantly get to download the Beta.

Then head to our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url] to chat with the community and directly with us!

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this Beta.

Stay Awesome!

notes.title: Get ready for Knight Squad 2!
notes.content:
[b]Knight Squad 2[/b] is happening and we thought you might want to take a look at it. We are making this sequel following all the comments and feedback we received throughout the years. It will have new modes, new weapons, new knights, and brand new ways to customize your matches.

[h2]Watch it in action:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=WBN1XqAjl-k;full][/previewyoutube]

If you had fun with the original Knight Squad, this game is being made for you. 

We invite you to check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660]Knight Squad 2 Steam Page[/url] today and wishlist it if you feel like it. If you want to know more about the game and you'd like to have a chat with us, come hang out in our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url], there's always someone to chat with.

notes.title: Try out Steam Remote Play Together, it's Magic!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058917/0c0b22d38d1bef3cff15dab8e84b4cb62f846d0f.png[/img]

Hello Knight Squad players!

Our game has been out for almost 4 years now but we have a bit of a news for you today. Steam has a new feature in Beta called "Remote Play Together". Using the power of streaming, this feature allows you to play Knight Squad with any of your friends online, [b]even if they don't own Knight Squad![/b] It's [i]almost[/i] exactly like playing on the couch. You might experience a bit of latency but that depends on many factors such as the strength and stability of your internet connection.

It's a pretty cool feature. It fits perfectly with the spirit of Knight Squad. We have tried it internally and it works fine. Now, we would love if some of you could also try it and leave us some feedback. It's not a Knight Squad feature, it's a Steam feature so we probably won't be able to fix anything, but we like to know where we stand.

If you want to try it out and have a remote party with your friends, here are the steps.

First, you need to opt-in to the Steam Beta Updates. You'll find the drop-down menu to do so in your [b]Steam Settings[/b], under the [b]Account subsection[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058917/945818df23298414e0e969ae5468a3364f018d0b.png[/img]

Second, you need to also opt-in to a specific branch of Knight Squad. You'll find the drop-down to do so in the Knight Squad [b]Properties[/b], under the [b]Betas[/b] Tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058917/6635d5c4cd8a5215ba485d1f851e736066438c47.png[/img]

Now, you are ready to try it, follow these steps to launch a Play Together Party :

[olist]
[*] Open Knight Squad
[*] Open the Steam Overlay (default shortcut is shift+tab)
[*] Click on the friend you want to invite from your list.
[*] Select “Remote Play Together.”
[*] Ensure your friend accepts the invite.
[/olist]

The system will automatically connect everyone. You can also voice chat with them using Steam’s built-in communication features. 

Let us know how it works for you!

Have a great day,

notes.title: Update #20 - Easier challenges, control remap and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://chainsawesomegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/update_on_steam.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Who among you noble knights have completed all of the 5 single-player challenges?

Well, part or this update isn't for the masterful ones that you are. Our newest update on Steam adds an Easy difficulty setting to the challenges as well as the option to remap all the controls and new polished visual feedbacks. View the full changelist at the bottom for more infos!

Update Knight Squad now and face the slightly less unforgiving challenges!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an easy mode to the challenges. The original difficulty is still available under the Insane difficulty
[*]Added the possibility to remap the controls however you like!
[*]Completely overhauled the in-game UI feedbacks to be 60 fps.
[*]Added the possibility of adding a password to your online game.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Trolls challenge
[*]Fixed the issue with the dark knights challenge where the waves upwards of 20 wouldn't save in the leaderboard
[*]Changed the way online leaving works to avoid issues.

notes.title: Update #18 - Getting closer to launch!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_18.jpg]
Hey folks!

It's time for an update as the launch is getting closer! This update is mainly fixes and tweaks but we managed to squeeze in another challenge. Plus, we changed the challenges to be locked in a certain order if you have not finished them yet!

Here's the changes breakdown :

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the names of the players in the result screen.
[*]Added the new Crystalor challenge
[*]Challenges are now locked if you didn't complete the previous one. 
[*]The dark knights challenge is now the last challenge as it's the hardest.
[*]Fixed an issue in online multiplayer with grails/flags/juggernaut pickables
[*]Fixed an issue with the scores not being the same on different clients
[*]Changed how the boomerang works, you can now throw multiple at a time if you're skillful enough.
[/list]

[b]Also, keep in mind that when the game fully releases (Nov 16), all Early Access backers will receive 4 additional game modes to fiddle with.[/b]

Let us know if you have any issues with this update!

notes.title: Update #17 - FINALLY an update! Lots of stuff!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_17.jpg]

Hey folks!

We may have looked very dead in the last couple of months but we were hard at work on the Xbox One version! With a small team, it's hard to do all at once! So here it is, update #17 :

[h1][b]Change list[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]FX trails on sword hits. Spin it and look at that cool trail!
[*]Names of the players are now shown in the UI. Know who you're up against!
[*]Changed the way the menus work. Only the first player has control over them and can go back even when there is other players in the character selection menu.
[*]Fixed the sound on the main menu intro
[*]Added the random mode
[*]Changed how the soccer is played to make it networkable.
[*][b]SOCCER IS NOW PLAYABLE ONLINE![/b]
[*]Bots showdown is now pausable and quittable
[*]Modified the dark knight challenge to remove the explosive arrows power up.
[*]Changed how the leaderboards work to add in the milliseconds for more challenge precision!
[*]Added 3 unlockable knights! The dark knight is a super easy one to unlock with how the challenges are setupped at the moment.
[*]Added achievements!
[*]Lots of online fixes and tweaks. It should be infinitely more enjoyable to play online as of now.
[*]Mac and Linux builds should hopefully be fixed. If that's not the case, make sure to throw a couple stones our way so we can fix this ASAP.
[*]Bots will now try to unfreeze themselves
[*]Bug fixes in the nest and troll challenges where you could walk off the face of the map.
[/list]


We also resetted the leaderboards since the score format has changed and that all the previous scores are now bad.

I'm most likely forgetting something but yeah it's a pretty big update nonetheless! 

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update #16 - Online Fixes, Dragons Challenge, New main menu!
notes.content:

[/list]

[/list]

If you find other bugs or something we might have missed, let us know so we can rectify it!

notes.title: Update #13 - Mega update de la muerte!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_13.jpg]

Hello folks!

We've been working for a while in the cave on multiple new stuff for you all! We really wanted to get this out the door before the weekend so here it is! Here's a list of what's new in the build :

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b][i]MULTIPLAYER ONLINE![/i][/b] Oh yeah the first release is here. Note that a lot of fixes and tweaks are in order and that this is the first update of many, but... it's here! P.S. The Juggernaut is pretty broken if you want to have some Wtfs going on.
[*][b]New challenges![/b] We've added 2 new challenges to the challenge list. 3 more are to come!
[*]A truck load of new maps. New maps for everyone!
[*]New animation for all the knights! We felt the knights should have a bit more personality, so we decided to give them some! Let us know which one you prefer!
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Big memory leak fix. This should fix issues where the game started running slow and doing increasingly big freezes when playing.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could start walking very slowly for no reason.
[*]Reset all the leaderboards since the first challenge has been tweaked.
[/list]

We also came to the hard decision to drop the Tower of Destiny from the game. Read more infos on the post I'll be doing on the discussions!

Let us know what you think folks! :D

notes.title: Update #12 - Ice Balista, New map, Lots of tweaks
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_12.jpg]

Hey everyone!

We're finally back from Christmas with a new build and promise for an even brighter tomorrow! We've added a couple things, tweaked a lot more and did some major fixes for the new build! If everything goes well, a beta version with the first playable online build should also be available next week after the PAX South.

In the meantime, here's the change list!

[b][h1]Features :[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added the possibility to change the end condition of each game mode (Ex : 5 rounds won instead of the basic 3 in Last Man Standing)
[*]An ice balista is now present in multiple levels. Beware not getting hit or you'll be frozen for a while!
[*]Added Disco party grail map, LASERS EVERYWHERE!
[*]Added the option to enable or disable the V-Sync since it can cause stutters with some NVidia cards
[/list]

[b][h1]Tweaks :[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Modified the get power up feedback to include the level of the power up your getting (Ex : Explosive Arrows - Level Max, Boots - Level 3, etc)
[*]Added a countdown to the stat screen
[*]Reworked most of the maps to change the tileset visual
[*]Modified a couple maps to add in fire breathing dragons
[*]Fire breathing dragons play a little animation when spewing fire and show smoke prior to firing.
[*]Animations are now fluid. Interpolation between them works properly.
[/list]

[b][h1]Fixes :[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Fixed controller issue when a controller got disconnected
[*]Fixed an input issue that would sometimes (often on some computers) miss attack inputs
[*]Fixed the win feedback that would display the previous' game winner before showing the good one
[*]Fixed an issue in the stat screen where moving your joystick would mark you as ready to continue.
[/list]

If you have feedbacks about the update, feel free to leave us a comment! :D

[i]- Jean Simon Otis, Co-Founder & Programmer at Chainsawesome Games (@rawkjs)[/i]

notes.title: Update #9 - Global power ups, the ripper and new juggernaut maps
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_9.jpg]

Hey everyone!

It's that time of the month again! We have added a couple things to the game and it's online for you guys' enjoyment! We added a new power up type and we would love to have your feedback on those as they might change the game a lot.

Here's the list of the features :

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][i]New global power up[/i][/b] : Freeze. Once you touch the freeze power up, your opponents are frozen in ice for a short duration. Use this time wisely to get closer to victory.
[*] [b][i]New global power up[/i][/b] : Reset. Getting the reset will remove everyone's power ups and reset them back to the default sword.
[*] [b][i]New weapon[/i][/b] : The ripper. The ripper will throw projectiles that bounce off walls and explode in a small area of effect . Everything it touches will be damaged badly.
[*] Two new Juggernaut maps. The old one was removed since it was poorly adapted to the game mode.
[/list]

This is pretty much it for this weeks update. Some pretty cool new stuff. Can't wait to see what you guys think about them!

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #7 - New Weapon, New maps and more!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_7_ks.jpg]

Hey guys! A new update is now live! We added a bunch of things and fixed lots of small stuff. As usual, feel free to comment on how you find the new content, we really like getting feedback to know how we should change things for the better. So here's the details :

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Lightning rod weapon : upon hitting the first target the lightning will accelerate towards the next closest target. Go for the longest hit spree!
[*]Unicorn mount : quite simply a unicorn! Find it for a funny effect!
[*]New Maps : A new Crystal Rush and Domination map have been added to the map roster!
[*]Disable Bots : You can now disable the bots when you are 2 players or more. Simply select Disabled in the bot difficulty selector. This still needs some tuning
[/list]

[h1][b]Tweaks[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the colors behind the power ups
[*]Renamed the Grail mode to Capture the Grail
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the leaderboard to show your score when you are more than 8th position.
[*]Fixed the challenge so that enemies don't spawn all with a sword.
[*]The result screen will stay the for a maximum of 30 seconds even if nobody hits a key.
[*]A draw in a team based game will now show everyone as sad.
[*]AI fix in Tug of war map
[*]When winning a round in last man standing with a horse, you will no longer look like you have a horse when respawning.
[/list]

We also removed the Kill Em' All mode since we felt it was too complicated and not that awesome. Plus it would prohibit us from adding in some new skins since the colors could end up being harder to tell in the kill em all. We will be adding a new Free For All game mode in the next update to compensate this removal.

notes.title: Update #2 - Boomerang, Horse and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update2KS.jpg[/img]

A new update is up and running now! We've added a couple of weapons and power ups to the game and did some minor tweaks to make the game more enjoyable! A lot of the time of the last two weeks has gone towards getting the game to work Online. This is coming together nicely. Here's what's new in the build :

[u][h1]Change Log :[/h1][/u]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]New Horse power up! This sucker runs fast and will tank a hit for you! The perfect companion!
[*]New Boomerang weapon! It will always get back to you unless it hits a wall. 
[*]New Protector Gun weapon! Using this will render an ally invincible as long as you stay close to him. INVINCIBLE!
[/list]
[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]A feedback has been added just before a power up spawn so you know in advance it will be spawning.
[*]Changed the Gladiator +1 to be +3 so they spawn less often but still give the same amount of points.
[*]Changed the color of bombs in team games. They are now the color of the team instead of the color of the player.
[*]Changed the ninja to be skeletal minions instead.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Really fixed the controller issue with cheaper controllers.
[/list]

[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Really fixed the controller issue with cheaper controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Knight Squad - Update #1
notes.content:
New build is available right now! The last week has been rather hectic as we have been showing Knight Squad at E3 in the Microsoft booth, but we still managed to get some things in for the update. We also added the new [b]Challenge mode[/b]! The first level is currently very experimental and difficult so let us know what you feel about it once you've tried it!

[u][h1]Change log :[/h1][/u]
[b]New Features :[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new Gladiator map
[*]Added a new Team Deathmatch map
[*]Added a new Last Man Standing map
[*]Added the new single player challenge menu with the first experimental challenge.
[/list]
[b]Tweaks :[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed how the bombs behave. They are now shot depending on the player's speed and explode after a short time.
[*]Bombs radius have been reduced from 4 to 2.75
[*]Added button visuals for the keyboard.
[*]Upped the Grail's value to 75 points
[*]Speeded up the Gladiator zone to give a point every 0.1 second
[/list]
[b]Fixes :[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the controls so that cheaper controllers also work. 
[*]Fixed the issue with being able to start a Team based game without selecting a team.
[*]Fixed the Pause menu so that it would work with a player that is currently dead.
[*]Fixed the Level selection menu so that it would work with the mouse.
[*]Capped the kill streaks to a max of 7 - Extermination
[/list]
